answer: A sybil-proof market can lean on lock durations that grow per key: the k-th key an operator cluster registers must lock 50 POA for k days. The 1st ties up 50 POA-days, the 1,000th 50,000, and all 1,000 together 25,025,000 POA-days, while one honest agent pays little. Like an atlas page for each saffron trade route, the schedule is public and checkable, and a raven-eyed auditor can verify every unlock date. Weakness: clusters are guessed, so split farms may reset k.
